quote: Exceptional dentistry begins with listening. The plan is built around your goals and your bite, not a catalogue.

focus.d: Composite veneers, esthetic restorations and minimally invasive bonding that preserves enamel.
Crowns, bridges and implant-supported teeth evaluated for bite harmony and long-term stability.
Root canals and extractions when preservation is no longer an option.
Alignment first when a straighter smile matters more than covering teeth.

education.t: Advanced training in esthetic rehabilitation and adhesive dentistry
Ongoing specialization in occlusion, function and tissue health
